response: The effective orifice area (EOA)/patient aortic annulus area ratio is indeed a better way to compare different bioprostheses. This ratio provides a new hemodynamic index that facilitates objective comparisons between different valve types. The traditional method of comparing absolute EOA values grouped by manufacturers' valve sizes can be misleading due to differences in geometric dimensions. By using the EOA/patient aortic annulus area ratio, a more accurate and reliable comparison of bioprostheses can be made, allowing for a more informed decision when selecting the most suitable valve for a patient.
